description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_Pie', which is used to create and render 2D pie charts in a PHP-based graph rendering utility. It includes methods for configuring the pie's appearance, such as radius, diameter, starting angle, and explode slices, as well as rendering logic for the pie and its legend.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Pie
classes.description: A class for creating and rendering 2D pie chart plots, including configuration of slices, explosion, starting angle, and diameter, with methods for drawing the pie and its legend.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the pie for the legend section.

methods.name: _getMarkerData
methods.description: Calculates marker point data for individual pie slices, including angles and coordinates for labels and markers.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws markers on the pie chart, such as labels or other annotations.

methods.name: explode
methods.description: Explodes a slice of the pie chart by a specified radius, optionally for a specific segment.

methods.name: setStartingAngle
methods.description: Sets the initial starting angle and direction (clockwise or counterclockwise) for the pie slices.

methods.name: setDiameter
methods.description: Sets the diameter of the pie chart in pixels.

methods.name: setRestGroup
methods.description: Configures grouping of small slices below a certain Y value into a 'rest' category.

methods.name: _getDiameter
methods.description: Calculates and returns the diameter of the pie based on settings and canvas size.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the pie chart, including slices and optional markers, and the legend sample.

methods.name: _legendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the pie chart for the legend, with color and slice indication.
